_note: The Visual Editor and visual_editor_enhancements, in the module iframe and the page iframe inside it.

steps.evaluate: (() => { for (const id of ['shot-crop-a', 'shot-crop-b']) { document.getElementById(id)?.remove(); } const r = document.querySelector('iframe#typo3-contentIframe').getBoundingClientRect(); const w = Math.floor(r.width / 8) * 8; const h = w * 5 / 8; const x = Math.round(r.right) - w; const y = Math.ceil(r.top); [['shot-crop-a', x, y], ['shot-crop-b', x + w - 1, y + h - 1]].forEach(([id, left, top]) => { const marker = document.createElement('div'); marker.id = id; marker.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;width:1px;height:1px;pointer-events:none;left:' + left + 'px;top:' + top + 'px'; document.body.append(marker); }); })()

(() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('ve-content-element[ctype=desiderio_featurecards]')[2]; cards.setAttribute('data-shot', 'rte'); window.scrollTo(0, cards.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 40); })()

(() => { for (const id of ['shot-crop-a', 'shot-crop-b']) { document.getElementById(id)?.remove(); } const frame = document.querySelector('iframe#typo3-contentIframe'); const r = frame.getBoundingClientRect(); const docheader = frame.contentDocument.querySelector('.module-docheader').getBoundingClientRect(); const w = Math.floor(r.width / 8) * 8; const h = w * 5 / 8; const x = Math.round(r.right) - w; const y = Math.ceil(r.top + docheader.bottom); [['shot-crop-a', x, y], ['shot-crop-b', x + w - 1, y + h - 1]].forEach(([id, left, top]) => { const marker = document.createElement('div'); marker.id = id; marker.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;width:1px;height:1px;pointer-events:none;left:' + left + 'px;top:' + top + 'px'; document.body.append(marker); }); })()

(() => { window.visualEditorEnhancements.elementLibraryColumns = 3; const panel = document.querySelector('ve-element-library'); if (panel) { panel.columns = 3; panel.searchTerm = ''; panel.searchResult = null; panel.selectedGroups = new Set(); panel.requestUpdate(); } if (!panel || !panel.open) { document.querySelector('ve-element-library-button').shadowRoot.querySelector('button').click(); } })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const started = Date.now(); const tick = () => { const root = document.querySelector('ve-element-library')?.shadowRoot; const grid = root?.querySelector('.grid'); let ready = false; if (grid) { const box = grid.getBoundingClientRect(); const cards = [...root.querySelectorAll('.card')].filter((card) => { const r = card.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top < box.bottom - 60 && r.bottom > box.top; }); ready = cards.length > 0 && cards.every((card) => (card.querySelector('iframe')?.style.transform || '').includes('scale')); } if (ready || Date.now() - started > 90000) { setTimeout(resolve, 1500); } else { setTimeout(tick, 250); } }; tick(); })

(() => { for (const frame of document.querySelector('ve-element-library').shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('iframe')) { try { const doc = frame.contentDocument; if (doc && !doc.getElementById('shot-hide-agentation')) { const style = doc.createElement('style'); style.id = 'shot-hide-agentation'; style.textContent = '#typo3-agentation-root,[data-agentation-toolbar]{display:none!important}'; (doc.head || doc.documentElement).append(style); } } catch (e) {} } })()
